items.title: 9.2.1 What is a Business Plan? (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of what a business plan is (PDF 209-210).

blocks.title: Business plan
blocks.text: Business plan aisa document hai jo karobari khayal, us ki kamyabi ka tareeqa aur maqasid tak pohanchne ke qadam bayan karta hai, aur shuru karne se pehle aham tafseel par sochne mein madad deta hai.

blocks.prompt: Business plan banane ka pehla qadam kya hai (MCQ 3)?

items: Business plan khayal, kamyabi ka raasta aur qadam darj karta hai.
